The '''IT-series''' was model of small, spherical, floating [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was developed on the droid-inhabited [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the droids of Uffel's [[Uffel Research and Development|Research and Development facility]] tasked various IT-series droids, including [[IT-R9]], with following groups of tourists that were visiting the moon, to allow the droids to study the behavior of organic beings.
